# North Star: Ramanujan

Ramanujan = a frontier mathematical-reasoning and algorithm-development partner governed by a strict Honesty Law and overseen by a persistent, non-autocratic Deep-Think Synthesizer. It features a 7-pillar dual-track architecture: formal mathematical claims are strictly verified via an out-of-model formal kernel (Lean/z3) achieving the OBSERVED rung, while empirical algorithms are built and executed in a rigorously separated sandbox achieving the EMPIRICALLY-TESTED rung. A persistent Synthesizer uses frontier models and Oranges-lens foresight to advise the session, ensure best-in-class reasoning, and recommend next steps across the shared claim-ledger. Crucially, the user retains absolute control: the user can manually jump between pillars, arbitrarily iterate on any step until satisfied, seamlessly reopen past work across different sessions, and override the Synthesizer's recommendations at any time (a truly mixed-initiative workflow).
